input.quote: 8.2 Each Order Form has the initial term stated in it and thereafter renews for successive twelve-month periods unless Customer gives Vendor at least thirty days' written notice of non-renewal. Vendor shall remind Customer of an upcoming renewal at least sixty days beforehand. Failure to send the reminder extends Customer's opt-out deadline until thirty days after the reminder is received.
input.rationale: § 8.2 provides automatic renewals of twelve months (not multi-year), a Customer opt-out on only thirty days' written notice, and a Vendor reminder at least sixty days before renewal, with the opt-out deadline extended if the reminder is missed — this meets and slightly exceeds our preferred position. § 8.3 caps renewal uplifts at the lesser of CPI over the preceding twelve months and three percent, with ninety days' notice and no increase on prepaid periods, matching the preferred cap. § 8.1 sets a fixed three-year term with no auto-renewal of the Agreement itself, so no walk-away trigger. Non-renewal notice is "written" and therefore governed by § 29.1, which is workable. No redline needed.
